ekf_local.purpose: Started by src/agrios_bringup/launch/localization.launch.py, this component executes ekf_node from robot_localization to run an extended_kalman_filter fusing /odom_cov and /imu at 50.0 Hz. It operates in two_d_mode to estimate robot state and publishes transforms with publish_tf enabled. It sets base_link_frame to base_footprint, odom_frame to odom, and world_frame to odom.
ekf_local.distinguishes: It is distinguished from its siblings by setting world_frame to odom.

ekf_global.purpose: Started by src/agrios_bringup/launch/localization.launch.py, this component runs the extended_kalman_filter algorithm from the robot_localization package using ekf_node. It operates in two_d_mode at a frequency of 30.0 to fuse sensor data from odom0 (/odom_cov), odom1 (/odometry/gps), and imu0 (/imu). With publish_tf set to true and world_frame set to map, it estimates the robot state and publishes transforms between map_frame (map), odom_frame (odom), and base_link_frame (base_footprint).
ekf_global.distinguishes: It is distinguished from its siblings by setting world_frame to map and configuring odom1 to /odometry/gps.

ObstacleLayer.purpose: ObstacleLayer is a plugin from the nav2_costmap_2d package that is started by src/agrios_bringup/config/nav2_params.yaml. Within this system, it operates as a plugin rather than a node to run the occupancy_grid_mapping algorithm.

SmacPlannerHybrid.purpose: SmacPlannerHybrid is a plugin from the nav2_smac_planner package that runs the a_star algorithm. In the agrios_ws project, it is started by src/agrios_bringup/config/nav2_params.yaml. It functions as a plugin rather than an executable node.
